condition: With the default bins="auto", data with a narrow spread plus a few extreme outliers makes numpy choose tens of millions of bins, so histplot/pairplot hangs or runs out of memory.
workaround: Pass an explicit bin count or rule, e.g. bins="sqrt" (or diag_kws={"bins": "sqrt"} for pairplot), or cap the count with min(bins, MAX_BINS). For pairplot you can also use diag_kind="kde".
